description: This file defines the Product model class within the Opencart e-commerce framework. It provides methods for accessing and manipulating product data, including retrieving product details, related products, categories, discounts, options, images, subscriptions, and handling product reports. It operates as part of the catalog module and interacts with the database via queries and cache mechanisms.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model class for handling product-related database operations in OpenCart's catalog module.

methods.name: editQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specified product in the database.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific product by product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products based on supplied filters and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Returns the total count of products matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Retrieves category data for a product within a specific category.

methods.name: getTotalCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Counts the number of categories a product belongs to within a specific category.

methods.name: getCodes
methods.description: Fetches product code records linked to a product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attribute groups and attributes for a given product.

methods.name: editOptionQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product option value.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Fetches a specific product option record.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns all options associated with a product, including their values.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific product option value.

methods.name: getOptionValues
methods.description: Retrieves all option values for a specific product option.

methods.name: getDiscounts
methods.description: Fetches discount records for a product.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns image records associated with a product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription plan info for a product.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions linked to a product.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches layout ID assigned to a product.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related products for a given product.

methods.name: getSpecials
methods.description: Gets products marked with special pricing.

methods.name: getTotalSpecials
methods.description: Counts total number of products with special prices.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Creates a new product report entry with IP and country info.
